summary: VTEX, a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release for the period ended September 30, 2026. Results showed GMV of US$5.5 billion (+12.0% YoY, +4.5% FX-neutral), total revenue of US$63.4 million (+6.3%), subscription revenue of US$62.5 million (98.7% of total), non-GAAP operating income of US$12.1 million, and non-GAAP free cash flow of US$13.3 million at a 21.0% margin. The release also disclosed buyback activity: 2.8 million Class A shares repurchased at an average US$3.85 for US$10.8 million. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory terms were stated; this is a routine quarterly earnings filing rather than a special situation.
